_comment: The 16 in-app purchases, as created in App Store Connect by tools/asc_iap.py (GitHub: Actions > Night Precinct in-app purchases). Same values as appstore/IAP.md. Product ID = BUNDLE_ID + '.' + suffix. A product ID and its type can never be changed or reused once created; names, descriptions and prices can.
